archiveBoundary: Three exact fixed original backup/prepare/failed-deploy directories; original manifest/result and every file hash verified before and after. New private output directory only, never modify or reseal originals. Failed deploy outcome/stage/partial service completion explicitly pinned.
sqliteBoundary: Only fixed sealed closed-before and after-start snapshot files via pinned immutable read-only SQLite connection plus immutable read-only ATTACH. SELECT/PRAGMA table_xinfo only, bounded progress deadline and row counts. No live database mutation, restore, cursor or sequence changes.
outputBoundary: Exact archived audit keys with bool/int only; typed-log differences reported as counts under fixed column enums. Policy only two validated integers/types; no settings object, log ID/message/data/body/user strings. UTC times are generated from validated timestamps. Full environment/config/source contents stay private/in memory, only equality/health/image/source and count booleans published.
runtimeBoundary: Read-only docker ps/inspect/exec tar and PID1 environ, git rev-parse, .env bytes+mode/uid/gid and maintenance inventory comparison. Checks expected partial runtime: test candidate, production original, all44 others baseline. No container signals, deployment, HTTP/login/provider request, config update or live business DB access.
evidenceBoundary: Original candidate StartedAt unavailable is explicit; supplemental closed-to-after observation window is labeled and never substituted for original startup bound. Diagnosis success means observations collected, not that mismatch is accepted or production rollout is complete.
activationCondition: Root must independently bind exact transport/helper SHA and original state/archive seals; only mechanical PIN=False to PIN=True may change from reviewed source.
